description: Lanes expected to fail. lanes: an upstream bug, oneloopmaster's scalar D0 has the wrong real part for a few real-mass boxes, in the exact expressions (generic engine in Float) and the native backend (fast engine, generic f64) alike, and OneLOop has the same error (README findings 3 and 5). ninjars case-check (--known-failures) and the rank n+2 tests compare these lanes with COLLIER's COLI quad value (collier_coli_quad_decimal) at a loose scaled tolerance (1e-6, --known-failure-tolerance): known-failure while they differ by more, stale-known-failure (a failure) once they agree, or pass their own tolerance, so that the entry is removed. The bug moves each lane by at least 3 % of its scale. inaccuracies: one engine at one fixed precision misses the lane's binary64 budget (README "Tolerances") although the reference is right: known-failure while the scaled difference stays within limit, a failure beyond it, and stale-known-failure once the lane is within its tolerance.

inaccuracies.reason: the generic engine in binary64 is off by 4.3e-7, 630 times original Ninja's error (6.7e-10) and 1200 times the fast engine's (3.7e-10), at COLLIER condition 7.2; the same with the shift invariants in place of the snapped S-matrix, so not the input ambiguity, and not cancellation between cut contributions (case-check --stability-test passes); Float(256) agrees with the reference within its uncertainty (1.5e-11). The rank 6 twin is fine (4.1e-10); the rank 8 lane is report-only (its new rank n+2 terms are 5e7 times the lane). Not traced.
